status: All ten independent reviewers completed. Fifteen findings have assigned seventh-round owners.

items.observation: On Home, a bare hourly search ranks A.Team first and the Work option returns only one unlisted hourly rate. The real pay=hourly filter returns 17 published rates.
items.acceptance: Support narrow hourly-pay intent and retain normal named-company and revenue search. Verify exact anchor and live record IDs.

items.observation: The adjacent 48 named / 21 program counts and 135 records include other kinds with no scope label. The measured clarification fits without moving the first role.
items.acceptance: Clarify the unfiltered tally and preserve filtered count semantics. Keep totals derived from current records and avoid claiming 48 open jobs.

items.observation: On direct Market with data or app bundle refused, the first Tab goes to footer About even though the native recovery is visible. Work control starts at Skip.
items.acceptance: Enable the fragment only when normal routing can show it. Retain native/no-script and delayed/retry behavior, normal heading/focus and next Tab.

items.observation: Native Companies Compare and profile departures lose the originating focus on cold Back, while query and scroll are retained. The next Tab reaches Skip; native Work footer does the same.
items.acceptance: Test cold and warm native Back, exact initiating links, next Tab, ordinary direct visits and query filtering. Check primary native Work Compare separately.

items.observation: Issuer says annualized revenue run rate crossed $375M. Native, Compare and Market present an exact $375M.
items.acceptance: Keep issuer terms with a qualified $375M run rate across all current views and downloads. Preserve historical canonical snapshot.

items.observation: Selected Toloka Fintel mirror rejected direct review; original SEC filing Note 3 explicitly reports the $26.1M FY2024 and $11.1M FY2023 amounts.
items.acceptance: Provide the verified SEC filing while retaining the original source/history, periods, discontinued-ops scope and USD units.

items.observation: Original syndicated release redirects to unreadable content. Issuer press release substantiates $300M annual revenue run rate; a direct automated request met a bot check.
items.acceptance: Link only to the positively verified original issuer publication and retain the qualification on the old redirected copy; avoid labeling bot access 404.

items.observation: The issuer identifies a named paid fellowship and asks applicants for a CV or relevant work samples. The current profile instead shows Location set per project although its evidence says location not researched.
items.acceptance: Preserve named fellowship classification and evidenced stipend. Present eligibility/location only to the extent the issuer supports, and link the original application instructions.

items.observation: Data identifies the archived PDF, but the undated reader still labels it Full report PDF and Complete HTML report, even though both are the fixed pre-registration archive.
items.acceptance: Label archive downloads near the links on the current surface, distinguish the current online edition. Preserve dated historical bytes and citation/edition identifiers.

items.observation: On a fresh #companies link after previous Back history, Firefox without the Navigation API restores stale Mercor focus.
items.acceptance: Restore on genuine traversal only. Fresh entries must get ordinary focus while retained Back entries remain correct.

items.observation: The Explore Work primary Compare results link loses visible initiating focus on cold Back. Native Work primary Compare is a passing control.
items.acceptance: Preserve exact Work state, prior initiating Compare control and first subsequent keyboard action across cold returns without stealing fresh or warm focus.

items.observation: The full profile action and the Compare column heading share an href. Returning from the row selects the header, so the next Tab removes the company; a unique href returns correctly.
items.acceptance: Identify the exact activating element/row without depending on href alone. Preserve the active column and normal alternate href.

items.observation: A link to native financing evidence inside the More disclosure loads the right native fragment, but fresh Back collapses the previously open details and loses keyboard focus.
items.acceptance: Restore the exact More disclosure, link, company selection and scroll on genuine Back. Respect normal fresh and warm navigation.

items.observation: Eleven historical Compare profiles use the link text Pay & requirements even when only careers boards, archived or information-only records are present.
items.acceptance: Use accurate route/availability labels for profiles with no payable listing. Derive the label from evidence; keep the correct destination, native fallback and company name.

items.observation: Back from an item permalink can leave focus on BODY. On the same dated edition this causes next Tab to repeat the previous headline; a cold filtered latest view moves the next Tab to Skip.
items.acceptance: Preserve the referring item permalink focus across same-document and recreated-document Back with exact filters/open details and sensible next Tab.
